{ set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
for d in "$root/.worktrees/profile-live-20261114" "$root/.worktrees/recruit-tumblr-merged-20261114"; do
 if test -d "$d"; then
  cd "$d"
  printf 'WORKTREE=%s\nHEAD=%s\nBRANCH=%s\nDIRTY=%s\n' "$(basename "$d")" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$(git branch --show-current)" "$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)"

 fi
done

printf 'PROFILE_REFS\n'
git branch -a --list '*profile*' | head -30
printf 'LIVE_IMAGE_BUILD_LABELS\n'
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{json .Config.Labels}}' 2>/dev/null | head -c 500 || true
 } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
